analysis: Spot buyers are absorbing aggressive perpetual short volume at the Value Area High, keeping price marginally above 60,500 despite severe negative perp CVD. However, low overall spot volume relative to derivative flows leaves the current breakout vulnerable to exhaustion if spot buying ebbs.
key_risk: Lack of spot follow-through resulting in a failed breakout and swift mean-reversion back inside the value area toward POC (60,400).
